body:
I smoked a bowl of this stuff and drank tea brewed from it, per the instructions on the package. Not only did I feel nothing, it was the nastiest-tasting smoke I'd ever inhaled. It burned my lungs right out of my body. It's the weakest, cheapest, nastiest way to get thoroughly un-fucked-up.
